title: Production Water-Thermal Provenance Readiness
scope: audit-only production callsite and accepted-substep quadrature readiness

invariants.assessment: Audit preserves the single canonical kernel and recommends composition into the existing F-KT path only.
No production I/O or file dependency is introduced.
Water mass, thermal state, provenance and future energy result remain explicitly separate data categories.
No persistent physical state is added; future quadrature is identified as trial/result metadata rather than continuation state.
No solver scratch is moved into columns; future accumulation belongs to trial/worker execution context.
Recommended design avoids per-column transfer histories after completion and supports fixed-size accumulated results.
Audit explicitly requires rejected trials to contribute nothing and outer publication to require the existing accepted commit receipt.
No committed state is changed by this audit and future trial-local accumulation is compatible with retry and warm start.
All reasoning uses generic accepted [t0,t1] intervals and substeps, not day/month/year boundaries.
No fixed coupling-window duration is introduced.
The bottom coupling interface is treated as a first-class production target rather than post-processing.
Direction-dependent bottom donor semantics preserve the explicit groundwater interface boundary; upward inflow may not borrow local SWAP temperature.
The audit forbids mass rebooking and requires energy to consume already authoritative accepted water transfers.
Existing interface sensitivity outputs are untouched.
Recommended quadrature uses existing accepted trials and adds no extra Richards or coupling solve.
The proposed fixed-size accumulation is MultiSWAP-compatible in structure, but production throughput is not yet qualified.
No one-to-one MODFLOW-cell assumption is introduced.
Upward external donor temperature remains external-source provenance and does not move deep-vadose composition into SWAP.
No component storage transition is changed and water remains booked exactly once.
The proposed hook is at generic transaction/runtime level and does not require one Richards implementation.
The audit requires reuse of admitted thermal and enthalpy contracts rather than duplicate physics.
Candidate snapshots and typed thermal views avoid any dependency on HeadCalc internals.
No physical option is silently altered by numerical policy.
Recommended accumulation is bounded O(number of already accepted substeps) and adds no retry loop or fallback solve.
Reference mode is unchanged; future energy capability must remain qualifiable against it.
Existing accepted_transaction_count and statuses support diagnostics, but future energy completeness/failure diagnostics are not yet implemented.
Optional energy accumulation can remain absent for columns/templates without the energy capability.
External donor-source composition remains a runtime/coupler responsibility.
No midnight, one-day, file-format or direct-MODFLOW hidden dependency is introduced.
This artifact explicitly evaluates all thirty architecture invariants for the proposed production seam.
